SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT A REAL NOTICE
This text was written for NativeForge Gate 81 parser tests. It describes no real
funding opportunity, no real agency programme, and no real deadline. Do not use
it as evidence about any actual grant. No opportunity number is claimed.

SYNTHETIC PROGRAM: EXAMPLE COMMUNITY INFRASTRUCTURE GRANT

PROGRAM PURPOSE

This example programme supports community infrastructure planning. Tribal
communities across the region have identified infrastructure needs, and Native
organizations have contributed to the planning process described in this
synthetic notice. This paragraph exists to be read as background only.

ELIGIBILITY INFORMATION

Eligibility is limited to federally recognized Indian tribes. No other entity
type may apply under this synthetic announcement.

APPLICATION DEADLINE

Applications are due March 15, 2027.
